basic_details.job_title: DRDO DRDE Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: The Defence Research and Development Establishment (DRDE), Gwalior, a Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) establishment, pays a monthly stipend of Rs. 37,000/- plus other allowances as per DRDO HQ policy to its Junior Research Fellows (JRF). It has invited Indian nationals with a First Class M.Sc. and a CSIR-UGC NET JRF/LS or GATE qualification for 5 fellowships (2 in Biological Science, 3 in Chemistry). Selection is by walk-in interview at 0930 hrs on 05.01.2027 (Biological Science) or 06.01.2027 (Chemistry). The duly filled application form is to be emailed to [email protect

age_limit.details: The age limit for both posts is 28 years, counted as on the date of interview. It is relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST candidates and by 3 years for OBC candidates. For other categories of candidates, the age relaxation will be as per DRDO Policy. | The notice does not name any experience requirement. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

how_to_apply: Download the application form from the DRDO website, www.drdo.gov.in.
Fill in the form. It must be submitted as a pdf file in the given format.
Forward the duly filled form to [email protected] and [email protected].
On the interview date, report by 0930 hrs at Main Gate Reception, DRDE, Jhansi Road, Gwalior-474 002.
At the interview, submit the hard copy of the duly filled application form with a recent passport size photograph affixed on the top right corner of the first page.
Submit one set of self-attested copies of the certificates listed below along with the form.
Self-attested copies of all degrees, academic qualification certificates, mark sheets, experience certificates, and the NET/GATE valid score card etc. (one set).
Original certificates/testimonials for qualifications, experience, age and caste certificate, for verification at the time of interview.
No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the employer, for candidates presently employed in a Government Department, PSU or Autonomous Body.
important_instructions: Electronic items such as smart phones, mobile phones, pen drives, laptops, CD-ROMs and any other electronic gadgets are not allowed inside the DRDE Gwalior Campus. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview or for joining, if selected. Candidates presently employed in a Government Department, PSU or Autonomous Body must produce an NOC from the employer at the time of interview. The notice states that incomplete applications will be rejected during screening. The numbers of fellowships may change as per organizational requirement.

content_sections.heading: About DRDE
content_sections.text: The notice describes DRDE, Gwalior as a premier institute of the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO). It is located on Jhansi Road, Gwalior. It invites young and meritorious Indian Nationals who wish to pursue defence related research as Junior Research Fellow.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: DRDE has advertised 5 fellowships in two subjects. The notice says the numbers of fellowships may change as per the organizational requirement.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian Nationals can apply. Age and educational qualification are considered as on the date of interview. Only candidates who have already been awarded the degree or provisional certificate are eligible to apply. The age limit for both posts is 28 years, counted as on the date of interview. It is relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST candidates and by 3 years for OBC candidates. For other categories of candidates, the age relaxation will be as per DRDO Policy. The notice does not name any experience requirement. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: First Class M.Sc. in Life Science/Zoology/Biotechnology/Molecular Biology/Microbiology/Pharmacology/Toxicology/Immunology or related fields, along with National Eligibility Test (NET) qualification conducted by CSIR-UGC NET JRF/LS or GATE (MHRD)

First class M.Sc. in Chemistry (Physical / Analytical / Organic / Inorganic) or related fields, along with valid National Eligibility Test (NET) qualification conducted by CSIR-UGC NET JRF/LS or GATE by MHRD

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The monthly stipend is Rs. 37,000/- and other allowances as per DRDO HQ policy. The candidate works initially for the first two years as JRF and is then upgraded as SRF for the remaining three years, subject to satisfactory performance assessed as per DRDO instructions. Candidates selected as JRF may be allowed to register for Ph.D. during the tenure of fellowship. The offer of fellowship does not confer any right for absorption in DRDO.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DRDE DRDO Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the DRDO website, www.drdo.gov.in . Fill in the form. It must be submitted as a pdf file in the given format. Forward the duly filled form to [email protected] and [email protected] . On the interview date, report by 0930 hrs at Main Gate Reception, DRDE, Jhansi Road, Gwalior-474 002. At the interview, submit the hard copy of the duly filled application form with a recent passport size photograph affixed on the top right corner of the first page. Submit one set of self-attested copies of the certificates listed below along with the form. Self-attested copies of all degrees, academic qualification certificates, mark sheets, experience certificates, and the NET/GATE valid score card etc. (one set). Original certificates/testimonials for qualifications, experience, age and caste certificate, for verification at the time of interview. No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the employer, for candidates presently employed in a Government Department, PSU or Autonomous Body.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is made on the basis of a walk-in interview at DRDE. Original certificates are verified at the time of interview. Late comers will not be allowed. If a large number of candidates appear on the prescribed date, the interview may be carried over to the next day. Antecedents of selected candidates are verified at the time of joining. Incomplete applications are rejected during screening. The notice does not describe any other selection stage or marks scheme. The venue, DRDE, is on Jhansi Road, Gwalior, at 1 KM from Gwalior Railway Station, near FCI Godown. The notice gives the DRDE phone numbers 0751-2341550 and 2342350.

faq.question: Q1. How many JRF fellowships has DRDE Gwalior advertised?
faq.answer: DRDE has advertised 5 fellowships: 2 in Biological Science and 3 in Chemistry. The notice says the numbers may change as per organizational requirement.

faq.question: Q2. When are the DRDE JRF walk-in interviews?
faq.answer: The interview for Biological Science is on 05.01.2027 and for Chemistry on 06.01.2027. Reporting time is 0930 hrs at Main Gate Reception, DRDE, Jhansi Road, Gwalior-474 002.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the DRDO JRF posts?
faq.answer: Both posts need a First Class M.Sc. in the stated subjects or related fields, along with CSIR-UGC NET JRF/LS or GATE qualification. Only candidates already awarded the degree or provisional certificate can apply.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for DRDE JRF?
faq.answer: The age limit is 28 years, counted as on the date of interview. It is relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST candidates and 3 years for OBC candidates; others as per DRDO Policy.

faq.question: Q5. What is the stipend for a DRDO JRF at DRDE?
faq.answer: The monthly stipend is Rs. 37,000/- and other allowances as per DRDO HQ policy.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the DRDE JRF walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Download the application form from www.drdo.gov.in and email the filled form as a pdf file to [email protected] and [email protected]. Bring the hard copy and self-attested certificates to the interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for DRDE JRF?
faq.answer: Selection is made on the basis of a walk-in interview at DRDE. Original certificates are checked at the time of interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is the DRDE JRF a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. It is a fellowship: two years as JRF, then SRF for the remaining three years subject to satisfactory performance. The offer does not give any right for absorption in DRDO.

faq.question: Q9. Will travel allowance be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview or for joining, if selected.

faq.question: Q10. Can a selected JRF register for a Ph.D.?
faq.answer: Candidates selected as JRF may be allowed to register for Ph.D. during the tenure of fellowship, according to the notice.
